name: Set theory (a small ZFC town)
note: Three ZF axioms as operations: pairing, union, power set. They build new sets from old ones. No rule names an agent: nothing here decides, refuses or consents. Two sets with the same members are one set (extensionality), so a rule that would make a set that already exists changes nothing. Power set is limited to small sets so the town stays drawable. Rules only reach sets of rank 2 or less, and the town holds at most 14 sets.
source: ZF axioms of Pairing, Union and Power Set

rules.label: Pairing
rules.receipt: ZF Axiom of Pairing: for any x, y there is a set {x, y}

rules.label: Union
rules.receipt: ZF Axiom of Union: the members of the members of x form a set

rules.label: Power set
rules.receipt: ZF Axiom of Power Set: the subsets of x form a set
